limitations.note: The agent changed the 9-cycle branch instead of fixing the 8-cycle branch, which still uses `div_e>>1` rather than `div_e>>2`.
The patch stretched the already-correct 9-cycle high pulse from four input cycles to six and widened both counters, changing behavior for some parameter overrides.
The test expected six high samples in both default modes, accepting the original 8-cycle bug and the new 9-cycle regression.
